name: agent-video-studio
description: An agent-first video player and editor: seek, capture, segment, transcribe, and take notes on a video through MCP tools and a rendered MCP App.
long_description: Agent Video Studio is a front-end-only video player and editor built for an external agent to drive. This bundle runs the studio's MCP server over stdio: Claude Desktop renders the studio itself as an MCP App (open_video_studio), and every other tool (seek, capture_frame, segment, transcribe, add_note, export_video, ...) dispatches through an instance-bound command bus to whichever browser tab or MCP App view is currently active.
